short: Audio memory (M02) and multi-head, multi-depth addressing (M06) are standard: the memory is the authors' own, heads add 0.3 LRW points in one run, and the LRW SOTA margin is 0.1.
position: The paper [@kim2022distinguishing] recalls audio from a memory (M02), inherited from the authors' [concurrent] ICCV design [@kim2021multimodality], and addresses it with eight heads at four depths (M06). Both are standard: in its own LRW ablation the heads add 0.3 points and the depths 1.3, from single runs. The LRW state-of-the-art claim is a 0.1-point margin over DC-TCN; the LRW-1000 lead over the earlier memory also changes the back end. Today SyncVSR reaches 93.2% on LRW without word boundaries [@ahn2024syncvsr].
